text.zh-CN:
头晕可以是旋转、不稳或快要晕倒，是症状而非一个确定病名。

- 像房间旋转常称为眩晕；发空、眼前黑则可能接近晕厥。
- 内耳、血压、缺水、药物等都能造成头晕，需要结合发生过程判断。
text.en:
Dizziness can mean spinning, imbalance or feeling faint; it is a symptom rather than one diagnosis.

- Spinning is called vertigo; lightheadedness may feel closer to fainting.
- Inner-ear problems, blood pressure, dehydration and medicines can contribute; the pattern matters.

text.zh-CN:
不同诱因提示不同机制。

- 起身后发晕可能与血压暂时下降有关；耳部感染或偏头痛可影响平衡。
- 炎热缺水、贫血、糖尿病低血糖及新用药也应考虑。
text.en:
Triggers suggest different mechanisms.

- Standing-related symptoms may reflect a blood-pressure drop; ear infections or migraine can disturb balance.
- Heat and dehydration, anaemia, low glucose in diabetes and new medicines are other possibilities.

text.zh-CN:
突然头晕伴神经或循环异常需急救。

- 说话不清、单侧无力、脸歪或新发视力异常，立即呼叫当地急救。
- 伴胸痛、明显气促或晕倒应紧急评估；疑似卒中即使缓解仍需急救，勿自行开车。
text.en:
Sudden dizziness with neurological or circulation problems needs emergency help.

- Call local emergency services for speech difficulty, one-sided weakness, facial droop or new visual disturbance.
- Chest pain, severe breathlessness or collapse also needs urgent assessment; possible stroke remains an emergency even after improvement. Do not drive.

text.zh-CN:
轻微短暂发作先确保安全，再观察恢复。

- 坐下或躺下，慢慢起身；持续不退或反复出现应预约就诊。
- 新听力下降、耳鸣、头痛或脉搏异常应及时联系医生，不能都归为既往耳病。
text.en:
First get safe during a mild brief episode.

- Sit or lie down and rise slowly; persistent or recurrent symptoms need an appointment.
- New hearing loss, tinnitus, headache or pulse changes need timely advice rather than attribution to an old ear problem.

text.zh-CN:
评估先了解类型、时间和伴随症状。

- 描述持续多久、是否由翻身或站起诱发，以及有没有耳部或神经症状。
- 医生按线索检查血压、脉搏、耳部和平衡，必要时进一步检测；并非每个人都需脑扫描。
text.en:
Assessment begins with timing, sensations and associated symptoms.

- Describe duration, turning or standing triggers and any ear or neurological symptoms.
- Findings guide checks of pressure, pulse, ears and balance and further testing; brain imaging is not needed for everyone.

text.zh-CN:
相似感觉并不代表同一种病。

- 内耳问题常伴旋转、恶心或耳鸣，但仅凭这些不能排除卒中。
- 脱水或体位性低血压常在起身时明显；焦虑也可引起头晕，但需结合病史评估。
text.en:
Similar sensations can have different causes.

- Inner-ear problems often cause spinning, nausea or tinnitus, but these alone do not exclude stroke.
- Dehydration or postural low pressure may worsen on standing; anxiety is another possibility requiring context.

text.zh-CN:
治疗应针对查明的原因。

- 缺水时补液，明确低血糖时按既定低血糖方案处理。
- 内耳疾病可能需复位或平衡康复；怀疑药物影响时由开药医生调整，不自行停药。
text.en:
Treatment follows the identified cause.

- Replace fluid for dehydration and follow an established plan for confirmed low glucose.
- Inner-ear disorders may need repositioning or balance rehabilitation; a prescriber should review medicine effects before changes.

text.zh-CN:
不存在适用于所有头晕的药物。

- 止吐或缓解眩晕的药只改善部分不适，不能证明危险病因已排除。
- 新用药后出现头晕应报告；可能使人困倦的药物还需注意跌倒和驾驶风险。
text.en:
No medicine suits every cause of dizziness.

- Nausea or vertigo drugs may relieve symptoms without proving dangerous disease absent.
- Report dizziness after a new medicine; sedating drugs also require precautions about falls and driving.

text.zh-CN:
饮食处理与病因相关。

- 没有限液要求时，炎热或缺水后适当补水，避免靠咖啡或酒精硬撑。
- 贫血和低血糖处理不同；头晕本身不能作为自行补铁或不断吃糖的依据。
text.en:
Diet measures depend on the cause.

- Without fluid restriction, replace water after heat or dehydration rather than relying on coffee or alcohol.
- Anaemia and hypoglycaemia require different care; dizziness alone does not justify iron or repeated sugar intake.

text.zh-CN:
防止跌倒和交通事故是第一步。

- 发作时停下并坐稳，缓解后缓慢起身；暂不驾驶、爬梯或使用危险机械。
- 记录发作时长、诱因和伴随症状，就诊时带上记录及药物清单。
text.en:
Prevent falls and accidents first.

- Stop and sit safely, rising slowly afterward; avoid driving, ladders and dangerous machinery while dizzy.
- Record duration, triggers and associated symptoms and bring the record and medicine list to appointments.

text.zh-CN:
已有疾病会改变风险判断。

- 老人需关注跌倒、起身血压变化及多种药物影响。
- 糖尿病患者考虑低血糖，按既有计划测量处理；不能描述症状者需照护者观察步态和反应变化。
text.en:
Existing conditions affect risk assessment.

- For older adults consider falls, standing blood pressure and multiple medicines.
- People with diabetes should use their established low-glucose plan; carers may need to report gait and responsiveness when someone cannot describe symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
病程取决于原因。

- 短暂缺水改善后可能恢复，内耳或慢性问题则可能反复。
- 持续、复发或出现新症状应重新评估；随访说明能否正常行走、工作和活动。
text.en:
The course depends on the cause.

- Dehydration-related symptoms may settle, while inner-ear or chronic problems may recur.
- Persistent, recurrent or changed symptoms need reassessment; discuss walking, work and normal activities at review.

text.zh-CN:
直接风险多是意外，其他危险来自病因。

- 跌倒可能导致骨折或头部受伤，驾驶及高处作业时发作也可能伤及他人。
- 漏诊卒中或心脏问题会耽误时间敏感的治疗，不能仅追求暂时止晕。
text.en:
Accidents are an immediate risk; other dangers come from the cause.

- Falls can cause fractures or head injury; driving or height-related accidents may harm others.
- Missing stroke or heart disease delays time-sensitive care, so temporary symptom relief is not the only goal.

text.zh-CN:
预防重点是减少已知诱因，并降低跌倒和意外风险。

- 起身动作放慢，炎热时适当补水，并管理已确诊的原发病。
- 复核可能致晕的药物，改善居家照明与行走安全，并知道急救信号。
text.en:
Prevention focuses on known triggers and reducing falls and accidents.

- Rise slowly, maintain appropriate hydration and manage identified underlying disease.
- Review contributing medicines, improve home lighting and walking safety, and know emergency signs.

limitations.zh-CN: 面向普通读者的扩充医学信息草稿，已核读所列官方资料的相关章节；逐项独立论证、地区适用性核准及医学签审尚未完成，不构成个体诊断或处方。
limitations.en: Expanded educational draft based on inspected official patient-information sections. Independent claim verification, regional applicability review and clinical sign-off remain pending; this is not an individual diagnosis or prescription.
